sections.text: You arrive at the edge of the Whispering Woods. Two trails diverge into the misty forest.

options.description: Take the overgrown dirt trail along the creek

consequence.text: Thorny brambles scratch your arms as you push through.

sections.text: The stone path leads you to a tranquil glade where a magical spring gently bubbles.

consequence.text: The rejuvenating water restores your vitality.

sections.text: Following the creek, you discover an old wooden footbridge crossing the rushing water.

options.description: Cross the bridge toward the ruin

sections.text: Rejuvenated by the spring water, you reach the summit overlooking the sunlit valley.
Inside the ruin, you discover the Golden Compass resting upon a marble altar.
